name: Financial Performance Assessment
description: Framework for assessing key financial metrics and performance indicators in quarterly earnings calls

dimensions.name: Financial Results
dimensions.description: Assessment of core financial metrics and performance

criteria.name: Revenue Performance
criteria.question: How did the company perform relative to revenue expectations?

criteria.name: Profit Margins
criteria.question: How are the company's profit margins trending?

criteria.name: Cash Flow
criteria.question: How strong is the company's cash flow position?

scoring_definitions.1: Poor cash flow generation, concerning trends
scoring_definitions.5: Exceptional cash flow generation, positive trends

dimensions.name: Forward Guidance
dimensions.description: Assessment of future projections and guidance

criteria.name: Guidance Clarity
criteria.question: How clear and specific is the company's forward guidance?

scoring_definitions.5: Detailed guidance with clear metrics and timeframes

criteria.name: Management Confidence
criteria.question: How confident does management appear in their forward guidance?

scoring_definitions.1: Management shows significant uncertainty or hedging
scoring_definitions.5: Management demonstrates strong confidence in projections

dimensions.name: Risk Factors
dimensions.description: Assessment of disclosed risks and challenges

criteria.name: Risk Disclosure
criteria.question: How thoroughly does the company disclose potential risks?

scoring_definitions.5: Comprehensive risk disclosure with specific scenarios

criteria.name: Risk Mitigation
criteria.question: Has the company outlined strategies to mitigate identified risks?

scoring_definitions.5: Detailed mitigation plans for major risk factors
